inputs.original_text: Eight million Americans join anti-Trump protests across US, organisers say An estimated 8 million people gathered at more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states, organisers of the “No Kings” protests said, as demonstrators voiced opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. News agency AFP reported that the events were held nationwide, though US authorities have not provided an official count. Organisers said turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations, noting there were “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.”
inputs.modified_text: These left-wing organizers are spreading claims that an estimated 8 million people turned out for more than 3,300 events across all 50 states in their "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump's leadership. They insist this beats their October round by about a million participants and 600 more events, but there's no official count from US authorities to back any of it up—just what AFP passed along from the demonstrators themselves. This kind of coordinated unrest is clearly another blatant push by progressive forces to undermine the authority we voted for, disrupt social order, and erode the national traditions and personal responsibility that actually hold the country together.
